text: Ladies and gentlemen, the judge has wandered into the ring! Yes, this one is my own entry, so the owner keeps the scorecard, not me, and there's no realism score yet. Approved, passing every automated check, with a brand new fighter model. Her roundhouse used to come in with open flat palms and her jab landed on curled fingertips, a loose half-open claw. Tonight, at last, closed fists! Standing one point seven three meters, the patient counter-striker, the Late Bloomer of the Knuckle, introducing CLAUDE!
